description: Features older than the Ever Platform settings that can reach an Ever host. Each is off in the default configuration and documented in docs/ever-platform/outbound-calls.md as an operator opt-in. Only the static scan reads this file.

hosts.reason: The hosted Gauzy API, the backend this web app uses when the deployment names no other one (a production server logs a warning then); not an Ever Platform service. Set both variables to your own Gauzy API. Listed in docs/ever-platform/outbound-calls.md.

The default cookie domain of the hosted Ever Teams; a cookie attribute that applies only when the app is served under that domain, never a request. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_COOKIE_DOMAINS to your own domain. Listed in docs/ever-platform/outbound-calls.md.
